title: I’m building a space survivors-like in Godot with the help of AI. Here’s update 0.4 and how I keep it balanced
author: vanerb11
selftext:
Hi! I'm a solo dev making Nova Collapse, a free survivors-like where your star grows with every kill and you choose when to COLLAPSE it into a supernova that wipes the screen.



I've been building it with the help of AI, and I wanted to share how the workflow looks after four updates:



\- Code: written together with Claude. I even migrated the whole game from Unity to Godot with its help, and now everything new is made in Godot.

\- Balance: a bot plays hundreds of runs with every ship, map and upgrade level. Before and after every change I compare win rates, so new content doesn't quietly make the game too easy or too hard. For example, two new weapons spread the upgrade cards too thin and evolutions dropped a lot, so we tuned how often key upgrades show up until the numbers matched again.

\- Testing: an automated self-test with 1,600+ checks runs before every build, and it takes a screenshot of every screen so I can catch UI problems (text that doesn't fit, images overlapping) before players do.

\- Player feedback: one of the new modules in 0.4 came straight from a Reddit comment.



What's new in 0.4:

\- 2 new weapons: a plasma boomerang that flies back to you and a railgun that pierces everything

\- New events: wormholes and dust clouds

\- New enemies: the Mender and the Miner

\- A Codex with everything you've discovered

\- Clearer evolutions and a new Settings screen



It's free in your browser, or on Windows and Android:

[https://varkness-games.itch.io/nova-collapse](https://varkness-games.itch.io/nova-collapse)



I'd love feedback on the game itself, and I'm also happy to answer questions about the workflow (what worked, what didn't).

comments.author: frigginwizard420
comments.body:
IME letting Claude use bots to balance your game is a trap 
The bots Claude made for me struggled with the game at every skill level, but actual player testing was that was too easy

replies.author: speaks-with-stone
replies.body: Claude is just a tool. Build your bots right and they'll do the job, this is a fairly standard discipline, and lots of literature on the subject.

replies.author: vanerb11
replies.body: Totally agree that bots can't replace real players. I don't use the bot to decide how hard the game should feel, only to compare: same bot, same seeds, before and after a change. If a new weapon suddenly drops the win rate by 10%, I know something broke. The actual difficulty comes from player feedback, like the calmer start in 0.3, which came from comments here.
